default: Default: any - Values: any, multi_pool, no_freeform
name: CHARACTER_POINT_POOLS

info: Turns off vehicle movement and autodrive while sleeping
name: SLEEP_SKIP_VEH

info: Sounds are not processed while sleeping
name: SLEEP_SKIP_SOUND

info: Monsters do not move while sleeping
name: SLEEP_SKIP_MON

info: If true, will show additional warnings for JSON data correctness.
name: STRICT_JSON_CHECKS

info: If false, the game will keep tileset in memory after first load to speed up subsequent loadings of game data.  Enable this if you're working on a tileset for the game or a mod.
name: FORCE_TILESET_RELOAD

info: Displays what content pack a piece of furniture, terrain, item or monster comes from or is affected by.  Disable if it's annoying.
name: MOD_SOURCE

info: Displays internal IDs of game objects and creatures.  Warning: IDs may contain spoilers.
name: SHOW_IDS

info: Debug information
name: DEBUGLOG_LEV_DEBUG

info: General information
name: DEBUGLOG_LEV_INFO

info: Warnings
name: DEBUGLOG_LEV_WARNING

info: Messages from main game class.
name: DEBUGLOG_CL_GAME

info: Debug-type messages from in-game message log (when debug mode is enabled).
name: DEBUGLOG_CL_DEBUGMODE

info: Generic messages related to game startup and operation.
name: DEBUGLOG_CL_MAIN

info: Messages related to map and mapbuffer (map.cpp, mapbuffer.cpp).
name: DEBUGLOG_CL_MAP

info: Messages related to mapgen (mapgen*.cpp) and overmap (overmap.cpp).
name: DEBUGLOG_CL_MAPGEN

info: Messages related to tile memory (map_memory.cpp).
name: DEBUGLOG_CL_MAPMEM

name: DEBUGLOG_CL_NPC

info: Determines the scope, which is known in the beginning of the game.
name: DISTANCE_INITIAL_VISIBILITY

info: Initial points available to spend on stats on character generation.
name: INITIAL_STAT_POINTS

info: Initial points available to spend on traits on character generation.
name: INITIAL_TRAIT_POINTS

info: Initial points available to spend on skills on character generation.
name: INITIAL_SKILL_POINTS

info: Maximum trait points available for character generation.
name: MAX_TRAIT_POINTS

info: Scales experience gained from practicing skills and reading books.  0.5 is half as fast as default, 2.0 is twice as fast, 0.0 disables skill training except for NPC training.
name: SKILL_TRAINING_SPEED

info: Set the level of skill rust.  Vanilla: Vanilla Cataclysm - Capped: Capped at skill levels 2 - Int: Intelligence dependent - IntCap: Intelligence dependent, capped - Off: None at all.
default: Default: off - Values: vanilla, capped, int, intcap, off
name: SKILL_RUST

info: Maximum distance at which items are considered available for crafting (or some other actions).
name: PICKUP_RANGE

info: If false, vision is limited to current z-level.  If true and the world is in z-level mode, the vision will extend beyond current z-level.
name: FOV_3D

info: How many levels up and down the experimental 3D field of vision reaches.  (This many levels up, this many levels down.)  3D vision of the full height of the world can slow the game down a lot.  Seeing fewer Z-levels is faster.
name: FOV_3D_Z_RANGE

info: If false, achievements and some Magiclysm functionality won't work, but performance will be better.
name: ENABLE_EVENTS

info: If true, enables somewhat unfinished electric grid system that may slow the game down.
name: ELECTRIC_GRID

info: Explosive items and traps will detonate when hit by damage exceeding the threshold.  A higher number means more damage is required to detonate.  Set to 0 to disable.
name: MADE_OF_EXPLODIUM

info: If true, disables new raycasting based explosive system in favor of old system.  With new system obstacles (impassable terrain, furniture or vehicle parts) will block shrapnel, while blast will bash obstacles and throw creatures outward.  If obstacles are destroyed, blast continues outward.
name: OLD_EXPLOSIONS

info: If true, injuries cause persistent pain until they are healed.
name: CHRONIC_PAIN

info: Set the minimum speed for the auto-drive feature.  In tiles/s.  Default is 1 (6 km/h or 4 mph).
name: MIN_AUTODRIVE_SPEED

info: Set the maximum speed for the auto-drive feature.  In tiles/s.  Default is 9 (57 km/h or 36 mph).
name: MAX_AUTODRIVE_SPEED

info: If true, bayonets replace weapon attack instead of adding to it.  WIP feature, weakens bayonets heavily at the moment.
name: LIMITED_BAYONETS

info: If true, opt out of new pathfinding in favor of legacy one. This makes pathfinding mods not work.
name: USE_LEGACY_PATHFINDING
